The '''''Luminous''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] and part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] affiliated [[Kuati Sector Forces]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]], at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later its successor state&mdash;the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;fought against the Galactic Empire. The ''Luminous'' and the rest of the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] Forces protected the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], vital to the Imperial war effort. New Republic forces [[Taking of Kuat|attacked]] Kuat that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weaponry]] on the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] of [[Surprise Squadron]] overloaded the ''Luminous''{{'s}} systems.

==Description==
A [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the ''Luminous'' was classified as a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
Part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Kuati Security Forces]], the ''Luminous'' guarded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the Galactic Empire fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], who would later be known as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In 8.5 ABY, the New Republic [[Taking of Kuat|launched]] an offensive against Kuat in hopes of securing [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards's]] [[Shipyard/Legends|ship building facilites]], vital to the Imperial war effort. After a transmission was sent from the Kuati battlecruiser [[Event Horizon (battlecruiser)|''Event Horizon'']], infected by a Republic [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Coded eraser virus|virus]], to the Republic [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] of [[Surprise Squadron]] in the [[Venir system/Legends|Venir system]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] to the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]] to engage the Kuati Forces.<ref name="Warfare" />

Surprise Squadron's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] soon took down the systems of the ''Luminous'' and three Kuati [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and as they attempted to get their systems back online, the same virus caused the ''Event Horizon'' and four Star Destroyers to aim their [[Turbolaser/Legends|batteries]] at the ''Luminous'' and the rest of the Kuati fleet. When hailed by the [[Minister of Commerce]] [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]] of the New Republic, who informed them that the New Republic controlled thirty-four percent of the Kuati shares, Kuati officials surrendered to the Republic. That was because they faced an enemy who could disable nine warships including the ''Luminous'' from their defense force in a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], as well as one that controlled a large part of the company's shares.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Luminous'' was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] on the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
